card.name: Words leading into named cognitive tests
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, as, and) or partway through a name, just before or inside a named cognitive, psychomotor or sensory test. Seen in descriptions of how memory, attention, driving or hearing were assessed.

modes.label: Link word before a test name
modes.description: The word 'the', 'as' or 'and' sits right before a named test or test list.
modes.example: memory function as tested by<< the>> Hopkins Verbal Learning Test Revised.

modes.label: Inside a test name
modes.description: The pole fires on a piece of a test name such as Hopkins or the 'Re' of Revised.

modes.label: List of tests
modes.description: 'and' or 'measuring' joins items in a list of tests of attention, reaction time or vision.
modes.example: symbol copying test,<< and>> the variability component of the divided attention test
